definitions.gloss: inefficiency; being inefficient; lack of efficiency
definitions.explanation: The state of not being efficient — wasting time, effort, or resources. Used as a noun and as a な-adjective (非効率な).

examples.japanese: {非効率|ひこうりつ}な⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{改善|かいぜん}する→改善する：26828_kaizensuru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{非効率|ひこうりつ}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I think this method is inefficient.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長引|ながび}く→長引く：14473_nagabiku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{非効率|ひこうりつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{典型的|てんけいてき}→典型的：04801_tenkeiteki⟧な⟦{例|れい}→例：09932_rei⟧だ。
examples.english: Meetings dragging on is a typical example of inefficiency.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{非|ひ}→非：28419_hi⟧ (non-, un-) + ⟦{効率|こうりつ}→効率：11794_kouritsu⟧ (efficiency). The prefix ⟦{非|ひ}→非：28419_hi⟧ negates the base word. Functions as both a noun and a な-adjective ({非効率|ひこうりつ}な).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {非効率|ひこうりつ}な⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧: inefficient work
- {非効率|ひこうりつ}な⟦{運営|うんえい}→運営：05096_unei⟧: inefficient management
- {非効率|ひこうりつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{排除|はいじょ}→排除：07631_haijo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to eliminate inefficiency
- {非効率|ひこうりつ}な⟦{組織|そしき}→組織：03320_soshiki⟧: an inefficient organization

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{効率|こうりつ}→効率：11794_kouritsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: low efficiency (more colloquial way to say the same thing)
- ⟦{無駄|むだ}→無駄：02512_muda⟧: waste, futility (focuses on the wasted effort/resources rather than the process)
- {非生産的|ひせいさんてき}: unproductive (focuses on output rather than process efficiency)
